top_signals.title: Alpine Linux rebuilds GitLab after attempted RCE attack
top_signals.summary: Hackers attempted to exploit a critical GitLab vulnerability in Alpine Linux's development infrastructure on October 20-21, prompting the open-source project to rebuild its GitLab server and reset all passwords over concerns of a possible compromise. [...]
